entities.summary: The Armenian Cemetery of Moscow is an Armenian historical cemetery in Moscow, Russia It is located in the Krasnaya Presnya district, not far from Vagankovo Cemetery. The cemetery was established in 1804 by the initiative of Minas Lazarev, the leader of Moscow’s Armenian community, who also initiated the construction of the Surb Harutyun Armenian church (1808–1815). The Lazarev family crypt is located under the church. The cemetery and the church are under state protection. Among the state-protected monuments are the obelisk on A.A.
